regions.full_page: Welsh, John W. - 34 - has sort of paralysis. At times can walk fairly well; at other times absolutely helpless; has been doctoring in many places without any success. Has Mother and wife & little child and a little business to fun - candy ..... Wondering at - Enjoyed other- wise and at sight of other peoples' troubles so much worse than his own was doubting if it were right to pray for own relief !!! Wife a convert ... Enrolled To-day $5.00 promises more frequent communion.
